title: Development and Effectiveness of Home-based Programs for Preschool Children With Developmental Delay
brief_summary: Early intervention refers to the provision of early detection, early diagnosis, and early intervention for infants and young children with special needs. The implementation of home programs is very important for children with developmental delay (DD). Therefore, the purposes of this study are to: (1) design the preschool home program activities(PHPA), (2) investigate the immediate efficacy of PHPA for children with DD, (3) investigate the long-term efficacy of PHPA for children with DD.The second year is to investigate the immediate efficacy of PHPA for children with DD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 0 to 6-years-old children
* clinical diagnosis of DD and other related disorders

Exclusion Criteria:

* unstable physiological conditions
* progression or regression symptoms
